capabilities: Fetch book metadata by ISBN from NDL, Google Books, and Open Library
Scan ISBN barcodes from back-cover photos into a CSV, with OCR fallback
Create book notes in bulk from an ISBN CSV file
Download, convert, and cache cover images as WebP
View and edit the bookshelf through Bases (Want to read / Reading / Finished)
extras: Desktop only (uses Electron file dialog and local filesystem); verified on macOS 14.4.1. Primarily targets Japanese books with 978-4 ISBNs; overseas books are not guaranteed. Listing in Obsidian Community Plugins is still planned, and installation via BRAT is supported. The different plugin ID lets it run alongside the original easy-obookshelf.
intentEvidence: This project is a derivative fork of easy-obookshelf, originally created by CocoaAI-IT.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to fetch book metadata from ISBNs or build a bookshelf of book notes from photos of back covers.
